nodes.label: Full Stack Engineer Intern at Metaverse Ventures
Awwwards Minimal Design Style
nodes.rationale: Single-page 'Awwwards minimal' redesign: light warm-off-white theme, big grotesk typography, custom cursor, magnetic links, scroll-triggered reveals, inertia scrolling, film-grain overlay, animated intro. High-fidelity recreation target; avoids 'rounded card + shadow' treatments — only small circles use border-radius.

nodes.label: Custom Cursor (Dot + Ring)
nodes.rationale: 6px dot follows mouse 1:1; 44px outline ring trails with lerp factor 0.18/frame via requestAnimationFrame. Disabled entirely on touch/coarse-pointer devices (matchMedia) so the native cursor shows. Ring scales 1.6x on interactive elements, 2.4x and shows label text when the element carries cursor copy.

nodes.label: Magnetic Links / Buttons
nodes.rationale: On mousemove within the element's bounding box it translates toward the cursor at 35% of the offset, resetting to translate(0,0) on mouse-leave. Applied to nav links, contact/footer links, code/explore links in expanded panels, and back-to-top.

nodes.label: Inertia / Smooth Scroll
nodes.rationale: Wheel events intercepted with preventDefault and accumulated into a scroll target; a continuous rAF loop lerps the real scroll position toward it (factor 0.14/frame) for a slightly-trailing feel. A scroll listener re-anchors the target whenever scroll wasn't lerp-driven so native keyboard/touch scroll never fights it. Nav/footer anchors use the same lerp target, never element.scrollIntoView.

nodes.label: Film-Grain Overlay
nodes.rationale: Fixed full-viewport pointer-events:none layer at 40% opacity tiling a 200x200px generated noise PNG, drifting continuously horizontally (background-position 0 to -200px, linear, 55s loop) — seamless because the shift equals the tile size.

nodes.label: Scroll-Triggered Reveals
nodes.rationale: Sections fade up (opacity 0->1, translateY 28px->0, 800ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)) via IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.15, fires once then unobserves). Project rows use the same mechanic individually, staggered ~40ms by index.

nodes.label: Preloader (Page-Load Intro)
nodes.rationale: Full-screen fixed overlay with centered 'SS' in Bricolage Grotesque 700. After 650ms the overlay slides up translateY(-100%) over 800ms with cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1) while the 'SS' text fades out over 500ms; pointer-events:none once the transform finishes so it never blocks input.

nodes.label: Touch / Coarse-Pointer Detection
nodes.rationale: matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)') — the custom cursor and inertia wheel-hijack fully disable on touch devices and native cursor/scroll are restored, so no gimmick fights touch input.

nodes.label: Dynamic Hero Word
nodes.rationale: Cycles ['Claude Code','agentic workflows','structured guesswork','trial & error','good vibes'] every 2.6s with a 220ms fade+slide out/in swap. Hovering the word pauses the auto-cycle (does not advance it) so the visitor can read.

nodes.label: Cursor-Following Preview Swatch
nodes.rationale: While hovering a project row a small 220x150px floating box with a diagonal-stripe placeholder pattern and monospace caption 'PROJECT SHOT — {TITLE}' follows the cursor at a fixed +26px/+26px offset, fading/scaling in. Explicitly a placeholder to be swapped for real screenshots/video in production.

nodes.label: Color Palette (OKLCH Tokens)
nodes.rationale: All colors defined in OKLCH for perceptual uniformity: warm off-white --bg, near-black warm --text, muted secondary, hairline --line, hover --wash, and a single moss-green --accent used sparingly (links on hover, tags, availability dot, dynamic hero word). No shadows, no card border-radius.

nodes.label: Typography System
nodes.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque (variable, weights 400-800) for display/headings — hero headline, project titles, section statements; Instrument Sans (400/500/600) for nav, body copy, tags, meta labels. Fluid clamp() scale, no fixed breakpoints; overline labels tracked uppercase at 12-14px weight 600.

nodes.label: OKLCH Color Space
nodes.rationale: Colors specified in OKLCH (convert to hex if the target stack needs it).

nodes.label: Hero Section
nodes.rationale: Full min-height:100vh, centered vertically. Eyebrow, 3-line staggered headline ending in the live accent-colored dynamic word with dashed underline, muted subtext, availability row (accent dot + text), and a bouncing SCROLL cue at bottom-left.

nodes.label: Selected Work Section
nodes.rationale: (09) SELECTED WORK overline + '2023 — 2026'. Nine expandable project rows (index/title/spacer/circular + toggle rotating 45deg to x), accordion panel (max-height 0->480px, cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) 500ms) with meta line, blurb, pill tag chips, and Code link; rows hover-tint to --wash with title shifting to accent.

nodes.label: About Section
nodes.rationale: (02) ABOUT overline, statement paragraph in Bricolage 500, and a 3-column responsive toolkit grid (auto-fit, minmax(200px,1fr)) of INTERFACE / BACKEND / AI LAYER categories.

nodes.label: Contact Section
nodes.rationale: (03) CONTACT overline, giant mailto link with animated 2px accent underline growing 0->100% on hover (400ms cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)), and magnetic secondary links (Resume, GitHub, LinkedIn, X).

nodes.label: Nav (Fixed Header)
nodes.rationale: Fixed top, blurred translucent background (backdrop-filter blur(10px)), 1px bottom hairline. Wordmark left; Work/About/Contact magnetic links right that smooth-scroll via the lerp target.

nodes.label: Footer
nodes.rationale: Hairline top border; © 2026 Sukrit Saha left, magnetic 'Back to top' that smooth-scrolls to hero right.

nodes.rationale: Agent-Native Workflows, Claspr, Limetta, Otaku-Sphere, Polymer Bazaar, Typournament, Mini-Portfolio, Spotify Clone, Twitter Clone. Note: README copy of the list is flagged stale in the project CLAUDE.md — the live source of truth is src/data/projects.js.
